_note: Phase 3 gate holdout — OWNER TO AUTHOR. CI's gate_holdout_integrity --verify step is RED by design until this is done (a green guard over an empty list is a false guarantee). Target: 48 questions = 12 answerable intents + 12 unanswerable intents, each paired EN/ES (24 answerable / 24 unanswerable, 24 EN / 24 ES). Constraints (Phase 3 plan sec. 7 / Task 8): NO paraphrases of eval_set v1.1.0 or regression_queries.json. Per-question fields: id, question, language ('en'|'es'), answerable (bool). Answerable also needs expected_chunk_ids (non-empty; every id must exist in ingestion/output/chunks.jsonl — do NOT invent ids) and expected_answer. Unanswerable also needs absence_note (a verifiable reason the corpus cannot answer it). When authored, set status to 'frozen' and run `python -m src.features.evaluation.gate_holdout_integrity --write`, then re-run --verify.
